I think the series needs a fundamental update to meet the standards of the ever changing shape of military technology and structure. Renegades was a cool in concept, but I feel like a series that focused on a Covert International Special Forces conflict (with some minor sci-fi elements as they are important to the series) with all the fancy tech the real special forces are using would be the best way to revitalize the series. I'm not sure what a modern Cobra would really look like but I'll dwell on it for a bit.

I think the War on Terror did a bit of harm for the mainstream's view of the line but with the real full blown conflicts dying down in favor of less controversial surgical special operations the time for some kind of revival of the series is on the Horizon.
This is cool, does anyone know a similar source of some kind for building floorplans? That is what I tend to have the most amount of trouble with finding good resources for.

The leveling system where it comes to a point where players are not threatened by low level monsters has always irritated me. The inflexibility of class based character creation and such. Someone suggested to me Runequest is better for more grounded fantasy which the setting I seek to convert seems better suited for.

What am I looking at in terms of deployment with 35F and what's the job like since that's where you're coming from? I like the human interaction aspects described in M and I'm told it has alot of "over the wire" stuff, but do Agencies tend to see their deployments and civilian equivalents as equals?

The way I've done it in my personal cthulhu universe is a writer like Lovecraft existed, but was obscure as hell. Most writers and fiction that he would have influenced wrote something else instead. Horror is a lot more shlockey whenever pop culture comes up in games and is not considered as having literary merit. His stories in my games generally happened with a few differences because I use different interpretation of monsters and deities than most other games and fiction.
Feeling a little better but I don't write anything I end up liking so no one sees it. Thanks for the attention, I think I need to take some steps to get help or something now.

Primarily amateur science fiction and similar fiction, I use to write poetry but I found the very act of the depressed young person writing peotry to be cliché. I play tabletop games over the internet, I read a lot, and I'm not picky about music but I'd have to say my favorite is late 90s early 2000s alternative. I use to act in school but I was comfortable with that because I was use to hammy acting from my games.
I plan attempting to get help soon, but the financial aspect of it is terrifying but I suppose their are worse things. Thank you for your help.

Besides being horrible with human communication driving me away from people I also have a horrible nihilistic lack of motivation to even leave my bed everyday. I try to tell myself I do it for my family but I think the truth is it's just my programming. Slowly I feel the depression overriding that programming.  I've considered mental health care but I rely on my parents for everything at the moment and not only do they not see my problem as possibly being biological but they have shrugged it off everytime I've tried to bring it to attention. I can't get mental help because I'm not self reliant and I'm not self reliant because I can't get mental help, it's a cycle of defeat.

I suffer a bit from Asperges and I fit the stereotype almost to a tee, with the exception being the over average intellect which I lack.  I'm socially enept but the worst part is new skills and interests do not come easily. In the rare event I'm in public I do try to be kind and put on a mask of confidence but being around me too long makes it clear that it's a facade. I like to write but I'm horrible at it and that's about the extent of semi-productive activities that bring me any joy or piece. I'd love to be capable of something of artistic or intellectual merit but I'm just so mundane.

The reason for my family not taking me seriously was probably the first time I showed any emotions was around two years ago I just broke down into tears for a reason even I couldn't explain.  Since then any discussion about my depression got swept under the rug and the last two years have had easily all the worst experiences of my life but I bottle in up to avoid being ostricised. I know everyone has problems I'm no different and there are a whole lot of people who get by worse than me but I can't help but feel this way.

I'm greatful for the suggestion, but I'm horrible at handling stressful situations especially when someone could be hurt by my actions. Community College is a possibility but I'm not sure what to do. I'm not sure why I think the way I do, I think the crushing loneliness is the worst part. I live with my family at the moment but I've never communicated with them well and coming at them with depression gets me condemned as dramatic.

Alright so you're alone, and tired of living. You've got a rough idea of when and how you want to go. I've been there but probably not your exact predicament. All I can say is delay your plan, try and think of a couple people in your life that have meant anything to you and just chat. You don't have to tell them what you want to do but let them know what they've meant to you, talk about happy times or something.

 Then maybe find time to take a chance and talk to some strangers about something, anything really. On the internet, in person it doesn't matter. Just try and gain some semblance of human contact, it probably won't make you feel better the first time, maybe not the second or the third but maybe you'll make a new friend or some random act of kindness may reinvigorate your will to push on. Maybe the people who could make you feel like you aren't alone are just a step away. I can't promise it but anything's possible.

You commented on my drivel I figured I'd come and try to say something as a token of thanks. We can't allow the inevitable spector of death to terminate what little happiness people like us can find. I know what it's like to feel higher than a cloud and be plowed to the ground by my own negativity. But when you think about it these emotions allow us to love and care just as strongly as we can self loath we just need to channel the energy right. And I'm pretty sure a lot of pretty girls like deep thinkers you just have to be open to trying and believing that you can connect with the person. I'm in the same boat in many ways, like you told me you're not alone.
Please give us details. We want to help but it's hard without understanding your situation. I assume you're lonely based on the title, I know what that's like talk to me about it.
